LanguageData.OOCMSB.NonCombatSpeedMult.Label: Non-Combat Speed Multiplier

LanguageData.OOCMSB.CombatSpeedMult.TT: Speed multiplier applied while combat is active / when the speed boost effect is disabled.\n\nRecommended to leave at 1 for regular use of this mod.

LanguageData.OOCMSB.ShowBoostToggle.TT: Show a button on the bottom right which allows for disabling the speed multiplier. Affects all maps.

LanguageData.OOCMSB.ManualReactivation.TT: If the speed multiplier is disabled on a map, require manual reactivation via the associated keybind.

LanguageData.OOCMSB.DraftedDisable.TT: Disable speed boost for a map when any colonist is drafted.

LanguageData.OOCMSB.OnOffNotification.TT: Show a message when the effect is disabled / re-enabled.
